vectors.name: duplicate-top-level-key
vectors.description: A raw JSON record with a repeated kind key must not be collapsed by a host JSON parser.

vectors.name: duplicate-nested-key
vectors.description: Duplicate-key rejection applies recursively, including prototype-looking keys.

vectors.name: duplicate-key-after-escape-decoding
vectors.description: Lexically different key spellings that decode to the same Unicode string are duplicates.

vectors.name: decimal-number
vectors.description: JSON decimal notation is forbidden even when its mathematical value is integral.

vectors.name: exponent-number
vectors.description: JSON exponent notation is forbidden even when its mathematical value is integral.

vectors.name: positive-integer-out-of-range
vectors.description: The first value above signed 64-bit maximum is rejected before identity.

vectors.name: negative-integer-out-of-range
vectors.description: The first value below signed 64-bit minimum is rejected before identity.

vectors.name: escaped-lone-high-surrogate
vectors.description: An escaped high surrogate without a low pair is not a Unicode scalar value.

vectors.name: escaped-lone-low-surrogate
vectors.description: An escaped low surrogate without a high pair is not a Unicode scalar value.

vectors.name: escaped-reversed-surrogate-pair
vectors.description: A low surrogate followed by a high surrogate is malformed Unicode.

vectors.name: utf8-encoded-surrogate
vectors.description: UTF-8 bytes that encode surrogate U+D800 are rejected by fatal UTF-8 decoding.

vectors.name: malformed-utf8-sequence
vectors.description: A malformed two-byte sequence is rejected before parsing.

vectors.name: unescaped-control-character
vectors.description: A raw U+000A byte inside a JSON string is invalid even though escaped controls are accepted.

vectors.name: leading-zero-integer
vectors.description: Non-minimal leading-zero integer notation is rejected.

vectors.name: non-finite-token
vectors.description: NaN is neither JSON nor a permitted identity-bearing value.

vectors.name: invalid-record-kind
vectors.description: Record kinds outside the lowercase domain pattern cannot enter the identity preimage.

vectors.name: wrong-canonicalizer-domain
vectors.description: A record cannot silently select a V1 or host-default encoder.

vectors.name: uppercase-content-digest
vectors.description: The textual content ID requires exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

vectors.name: content-digest-mismatch
vectors.description: The well-formed SHA-256 of the canonical body cannot substitute for the domain-separated content digest.

vectors.name: trailing-json-value
vectors.description: A valid record followed by another value is not one canonical record.

vectors.name: noncanonical-object-key-order
vectors.description: A decoder may normalize this object, but an already-canonical byte validator rejects its descending key order.

vectors.name: noncanonical-short-control-escape
vectors.description: The legal JSON short newline escape is not the required canonical lowercase \u00xx spelling.

vectors.name: noncanonical-escaped-nonascii
vectors.description: A valid scalar other than U+0000 through U+001F must be emitted directly as UTF-8.

vectors.name: noncanonical-whitespace
vectors.description: Insignificant whitespace is accepted for normalization but forbidden in canonical bytes.

vectors.name: noncanonical-negative-zero
vectors.description: Negative zero normalizes to the minimal integer spelling zero and is not canonical input bytes.
